training.target_noise: Original free-only nested Hungarian OT permutes only Z; actual target/source face and corner identities follow target slots
training.FM_denominator: Original total effective-batch valid free coordinates
training.geometry_denominator: Each sample defined mean; sum over all eight samples divided by8, with inactive samples contributing0
training.coordinate_scale: Only loss coordinates divide by fixed full-GT bbox diagonal; model/input coordinates unchanged
training.precision: Original BF16 generator; FP32 parameters/integration/geometric computation with geometric autocast disabled

L3.name: Along-interface-edge tangential relaxation
L3.parallel: tau*tau^T*r; tau is fixed GT shared-edge unit tangent
L3.relations: Trusted known-free source edge endpoints, with normal multiple-edge incidence weighting
L3.limitations: No projection, welding, or exact-edge guarantee

L5.name: Multiscale area and unsigned-normal surface measure
L5.quadrature: Same three symmetric barycentric points as L4
L5.weights: w_pred=A_pred/(3*A_GT_total), w_GT=A_GT/(3*A_GT_total), with detached GT total area; prediction is not mass-renormalized
L5.Q: n*n^T; normalized cross product with epsilon1e-8
L5.GTGT_cache: Detached GT-GT kernels only; actual kernel counts separate
L5.limitations: Finite quadrature, unsigned normal and surface-measure approximation, not exact topology or self-intersection guarantee

initialization: Both new branches from G0_2500, same historical500-batch segment, fresh AdamW; final3000

calibration.lambda_edge: lambda3*median(||g3||)/median(||gE||) on same applicable finite states
calibration.joint_diagnostics: norms/cos(g3,g5)/cos(gE,g5), weighted joint norms and cosine to FM; no gradient surgery
calibration.training_probe: step100/500 first active micro; NONE if no active; original full-batch denominator and aux /8

evaluation.sampler: Original native_t1.clamped_sample, no GT OT/loss/guidance/auxiliary network/postprocessing
evaluation.thresholds_and_points: Unchanged independent evaluator and previous frozen evaluation bank
evaluation.aggregate: Paired within seed in each parent/patch, mean4 then equal mean6 cells; all outputs retained

factorial.scope: Fixed coefficients; no equal-total-supervision control, no pure mechanism synergy claim

edge_comparison.scope: D_edge replaces L3 only in fixed L5 background; no D_edge-only arm

teacher.samples: Same saved calibrated8 samples, read-only actual3000 endpoints, not update-before500 logs

failure_policy: Preserve failed calls and partial updates; no retry/retune. Invalid edge calibration stops JEdge5 with no fallback; J35 remains independently eligible.
inherited_BF16_permutation: Historical baseline-inheritance FAIL unchanged; no replay of old investigation or relaxed tolerance
stop: Two500-update branches and fixed120-output evaluation only; no added loss/seed/steps, default switch, commit/push or deletion
